title: WorkContainer v1 (RATIFIED 2026-07-05)
$comment: STATUS: v1 — RATIFIED 2026-07-05 (operator, Option A per docs/campaigns/public-mvp/ratification-memo-work-container-v1.md). First provider: claude_code, STRUCTURALLY conformant (registered, fail-closed) with live supervised evidence via CD-4B (sess_aabb2a056f9f); RUNTIME (container-consumption) conformance not yet demonstrated — gated on S4 dispatch wiring. Schema changes from here are versioned (v1 → v2), not silent. This schema exports names for existing AG law; it does not create a new authority surface. A schema-valid WorkContainer is NEVER admission: possession/validity is not sufficient to invoke or rely — the admission_ref points to the AG gate receipt that admitted the work, and reliance requires re-verifying that receipt, not trusting the container. WorkContainer carries admitted work across provider boundaries; it does NOT admit work, grant standing, or replace RationCard/ReviewPacket/governed_dispatch. No law-bearing field is invented; scope/ration are read-only PROJECTIONS of a RationCard (a provider may only further restrict them, never treat them as the grant). See docs/api/work-container-contract.md.

sha256Ref.description: Content-addressed reference. Discipline reused from gate_receipt.canonical_json + sha256 hex.

capabilityClass.$comment: vocabulary reused verbatim from chain_gate.CapabilityClass — not a new enum.

work_id.$comment: Fresh container identifier. NOT projected from a shipped object; it is envelope metadata, not a law-bearing field.

admission_ref.$comment: projects from: gate_receipt.GateReceipt (the AG admission/dispatch decision that admitted this work). REQUIRED — a container without it is not admitted work. This ref is a citation to be RE-VERIFIED, never a substitute for verifying it. does not mint: authority.

origin.$comment: projects from: plan_review.Proposal (proposal_ref) / playbooks PlaybookSpec|QueuedPlaybook digest (playbook_ref) / standing verification receipt (standing_basis_ref). does not mint: standing.

submitted_by.description: Actor label, e.g. 'agent:claude-code'. Label only, not standing.

standing_basis_ref.description: Reference to the standing verification receipt. Not a grant; a citation.

intent.description: One-sentence outcome. Advisory prose, not a permission.

capability_requirements.$comment: A REQUIREMENT expressed in the chain_gate.CapabilityClass vocabulary (not projected from a shipped instance): the CapabilityClass values a provider must support to accept this container.
capability_requirements.description: CapabilityClass values a provider must support to accept this container.

admission_basis.$comment: projects from: the admitted governed-plan governance block (plan-envelope-v0 governance) — the citation set the AG/M-1 admission verified. This is a RE-VERIFIABLE RECORD of citation verification state, NOT a grant: admission_ref (top-level) remains the thing to re-verify. A projection whose all_citations_verified is false MUST NOT be produced (fail-closed). does not mint: authority.

ref.$comment: The cited content-address (sha256:<hex>) or witness reference (e.g. an approval-witness filename). Free-form because approval_ref is a witness path, not a digest.

verified.$comment: Whether admission independently resolved this citation against its witness. A container is only produced when every load-bearing citation is verified.

all_citations_verified.$comment: Conjunction over citations[].verified. Must be true for a produced container; false is unrepresentable (the projector refuses).

routing.$comment: projects from: the governed plan's declared harness (plan-envelope-v0 harness) — a LABEL naming a provider a governed_dispatch MAY select. This is routing eligibility, NOT trust and NOT a grant: registry presence/absence never alters admission, and provider selection remains governed_dispatch's decision. does not grant: trust.

eligible_provider.$comment: provider_id label (matches provider_descriptor.v1 provider_id when registered). A candidate, not a permission.

produced_receipts.$comment: projects from: the PRODUCED provider testimony for this container (ReviewPacket / obstruction / supervised run identity). This block is TESTIMONY, never AG admission — provider success/status here can NEVER be read as admitted success (§4.1). Reliance still requires re-verifying admission_ref and re-running the ReviewPacket validator. does not mint: authority. Optional: absent for a container that has not yet been dispatched.

review_packet_ref.$comment: Content-address of the produced review_packet.v0 manifest. A reference to re-validate, not to trust.

review_packet_status.$comment: The ReviewPacket's own status vocabulary (review_packet.py REVIEW_PACKET_STATUSES). Provider-reported lifecycle, not an AG verdict.

obstruction_ref.$comment: Content-address of a produced obstruction/partial-result artifact, when the run obstructed instead of reaching a packet.

run_session_id.$comment: The supervised runtime session id (e.g. sess_...). Identity/audit, not authority.

promotion_id.$comment: The runtime promotion id (e.g. prom_...). Identity/audit, not authority.

scope_projection.$comment: projects from: playbooks.RationCard allowed_write_paths + QueuedPlaybook allowed_paths/forbidden_paths. READ-ONLY snapshot of the cited RationCard (source_ref). NOT a grant: a provider MAY only further restrict; it may never treat this as permission. AG dispatch (governed_dispatch) remains the enforcement source. does not grant: permission.

source_ref.$comment: Digest of the RationCard/QueuedPlaybook this scope projects from. Required so the projection is re-verifiable against its source.

allowed_write_paths.$comment: projects from: RationCard.allowed_write_paths (write scope, kept distinct from read).

ration_projection.$comment: projects from: playbooks.RationCard (ration_card.py) locked axes. READ-ONLY snapshot of the cited RationCard (source_ref). does not replace RationCard; does not grant permission; a provider may only further restrict.

source_ref.$comment: Digest of the RationCard this ration projects from.

acceptance.$comment: projects from: plan-envelope-v0 acceptance_criteria + required outputs.

stop_conditions.$comment: projects from: plan-envelope-v0 stop_conditions (halt_if / forbidden_paths / budget).

receipt_expectations.$comment: projects from: gate_receipt.GateReceipt + ReviewPacket. Declares what testimony the provider must return; does not itself certify anything.

custody.$comment: projects from: gate_receipt.canonical_json seal + RecompositionReceipt lineage. does not mint: authority. decomposition_lineage records custody; recomposition can only refuse (RecompositionRefusal).

digest.description: Seal over the canonical container body.
